findings.title: User view endpoint allows any authenticated user to view another user's record via uid parameter

evidence.why: No user_id ownership check in WHERE clause

findings.attack_scenario: User A sends GET /admin.php?action=view&uid=<user id of user B> and receives B's user record.
findings.impact: Read other users' personal data (name, email, role).
findings.recommendation: Add AND user_id = :session_user_id to the query or load the record then compare owner and return 404 on mismatch.

findings.recommendation: Add AND user_id = :session_user_id to the query or load the record then compare owner and return 404 on mismatch.
